_annotation: Structured clinical & billing constraints for the OmniOS compliance state machine. Every rule is machine-checkable; severity 'reject' rules hard-stop the pipeline and route to HUMAN_OVERRIDE.

sources: ICD-10-CM code structure (category letter+digits, optional 1-4 char extension after the dot)
AMA CPT 2021+ office/outpatient E/M guidelines (99202-99205 new, 99212-99215 established; total-time bands)
Medical-necessity linkage principle: every billed procedure must be justified by at least one documented diagnosis
GDPR Art.9/25/32 + HIPAA minimum-necessary: claims carry pseudonymized tokens only
provenance.honest_note: No client documents were attached at generation time; constraints derive from the official coding structures above. When a clinic uploads its payer contracts, rules are ADDED here — the engine does not change.

entities._annotation: Required data fields for automated ICD-10 / CPT mapping. PII fields are ALWAYS tokenized at the edge before any orchestration.

patient.token: string — pseudonym issued by the local EdgeAnonymizer vault (e.g. [REDACTED_NAME_1]); raw identity NEVER enters the pipeline
patient.consent: boolean — GDPR Art.9 lawful basis; absence blocks any outbound communication

encounter.patient_type: enum: new | established — selects the E/M code family
encounter.total_minutes: number|null — total time on the date of the encounter; drives time-based E/M selection

note.text_redacted: string — the clinical narrative AFTER local PII tokenization

diagnosis.evidence_term: string — the exact narrative span that supports the code
diagnosis.evidence_score: float 0..1 — 0.99 exact lexicon hit, 0.90 stem hit; anything weaker routes to a human

procedure.linked_icd10: list — the diagnoses that establish medical necessity (must be non-empty unless justified_by contains '*')

claim.actor: who approved: system(auto) above the gate, clinician_id below it

icd10_lexicon._annotation: Exact Greek narrative terms → ICD-10-CM. Exact hits score 0.99. Deliberately high-precision: the engine codes only what it can defend; everything else goes to the clinician.

icd10_stems._annotation: Inflection-tolerant stems (Greek morphology) → ICD-10. Stem hits score 0.90 — BELOW the 0.96 gate by design, so stem-only extraction always freezes for human review. High precision beats silent guessing in claims.

cpt_rules._annotation: Narrative terms → CPT procedures with the medical-necessity linkage (justified_by = ICD-10 prefixes that justify the procedure; '*' = any documented diagnosis).

em_table._annotation: AMA CPT 2021+ total-time bands (minutes) for office/outpatient E/M. Selection by encounter.total_minutes; a stated-time hit scores 0.98.

coding_rules.rationale: ICD-10-CM structural validity — malformed codes are auto-denied by payers.
CPT codes are 5 characters (4 digits + digit/letter).
Every CPT must be justified by ≥1 documented ICD-10 whose prefix appears in the procedure's justified_by list. Unjustified procedures are the #1 audit/clawback trigger.
A claim with zero documented diagnoses is not billable.
The selected E/M level must match the documented total time band for the patient type (CPT 2021 time-based selection).
Codes ending in '99' (unlisted) always require human review before submission.
Any mention of a controlled/scheduled substance in the narrative always requires human review before submission (prescribing-liability + regulatory).
The outbound claim payload must contain ZERO detectable PII — only vault tokens (GDPR Art.25/32, HIPAA minimum-necessary).

Each billed procedure should be reachable from a documented diagnosis through the clinical causal graph (symptom → pathophysiological vector → clinical decision). Missing paths are flagged for review, never silently passed — but the authoritative gate remains the justified_by linkage (the graph's coverage is finite and honest about it).

causal_seeds._annotation: Clinical causal DAG edges: [cause, effect, mechanism]. Hierarchy: diagnosis → pathophysiological vector → clinical decision (procedure). Interventions use Pearl-style graph surgery (do(X) removes X's incoming edges).
edges: sustained hypertension loads the cardiovascular system
chest pain raises acute cardiac concern
ECG is first-line for chest-pain triage

guardrails._annotation: Risk-tiered gating: platform-wide floor 0.95 · financial/claims 0.96 · regulated clinical documentation 0.978 (the strictest tier — physician-facing autogenerated documentation). One number per risk class, each defensible.
guardrails._triggers_note: Each trigger here is ENFORCED in _audit_node → high_risk failure → FREEZE. A monetary claim-total threshold is intentionally NOT listed: this coding pipeline emits ICD-10/CPT codes, not reimbursement amounts, so the manifest asserts only what the code actually enforces.
guardrails.on_breach: FREEZE state → HUMAN_OVERRIDE node → clinician approve/reject → audit(who/why/evidence)
guardrails.rehydration: If the state would freeze for missing information (DX-REQUIRED or sub-floor confidence) and the context had been compressed, the FULL raw context is re-hydrated and the reasoning cycle re-runs once before freezing.

billing._annotation: Value-based SaaS: fee = 10% of MEASURED savings. Baselines are stated so a finance reviewer can trace every €.
billing.baseline_rationale: Overhage & McCallie, Annals of Internal Medicine 2020 (Cerner, 2191 orgs): 16 min 14 s of EHR time PER ENCOUNTER. Our 15-min baseline sits BELOW the published figure — savings math is conservative by construction. See CLINICAL-VALUE.md.
billing.physician_rationale: When the PHYSICIAN does their own documentation/coding (typical in Greek private practices), the opportunity cost is physician time, not coder time.
